title: YDS Sınav Kursu | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: YDS Sınav Kursu. Category: Entrepreneurship. Duration: 2 months. Description: A completely free, face-to-face English preparation course for students preparing for the YDS (Foreign Language Exam) and YOKDIL. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
